title: Implement word frequency counter in Go
description: Implement WordCount(s string) map[string]int that returns a word frequency map (case-insensitive, strips punctuation), and TopN(counts map[string]int, n int) []string that returns the top-n words sorted by frequency descending then alphabetically.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement WordCount and TopN in wordcount.go:
- `WordCount(s string)`: split on whitespace, lowercase each word, strip leading/trailing non-letter runes (use strings.TrimFunc + unicode.IsLetter), count in map
- `TopN(counts, n)`: sort keys by (-count, name) ascending; return first n
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
